title: Thingstudio board definition
description: A ~/.thingstudio/boards/<id>.json file, or a built-in under editor/src/definitions/boards/. The file name without .json is the id (lowercase letters, digits, - and _). Authoritative prose: interfaces/board-descriptor/SPEC.md; user walkthrough: docs/user-guide/boards.md.

name.description: Name shown in the Board menu.

processor.description: Id of a known processor, e.g. esp32-c3.

match.description: Board names MicroPython reports, for Auto. Exact (case-insensitive) against the part of chipType before ' with '. Use [] to pick the board by hand.

pins.description: Label -> pin (a GPIO number 0-255, or a named pin like "X1"). Labels non-empty and unique; each pin must exist on the board.

gpio.description: The pins this board has, if fewer than its processor. Must be pins the processor has.

reserved.description: Pins that must not be used, with a reason each. Keys must exist on the board.

avoid.description: Pins that warn, with a reason each. Keys must exist on the board.

free.description: Pins the processor reserves or warns about that are fine on this board. Must exist on the board, and not also be in this board's reserved or avoid.

notes.description: Anything worth knowing, shown on the Pins page.

wifi.description: false if the board has no WiFi radio (hides WiFi connect). Omit if unsure.

capabilities.description: Hardware features this board adds to (or, via wifi: false, takes from) its processor's set. A node's requires.capabilities is checked against these at compile time.

header.description: Physical pin name (e.g. "1", or "P3-1") -> a pin (GPIO number or a named pin) or a label like "GND"/"3V3". A string that names a pin on this board is that pin; any other string is a label. Pins must exist on the board and appear at most once.

headerOrder.description: How a 1..N dual-row header is numbered: 'around' down one side and back up the other (the Pico); 'down' down both sides. Needs header. Default 'around'.

usb.description: Which end the USB connector is at, pin 1 at the top left. Needs header.

firmware.description: How to flash this board from blank, for the editor's Install firmware action. Omit if unknown.

pinId.description: A named pin on a processor whose pins aren't numbered, e.g. the pyboard's "X1" or "A13".

pinList.description: Pins as numbers (0-255), range strings like "4-7", or named pins like "X1".

pinReasons.description: Pin or range (as a key, e.g. "6-11", or a name) -> a non-empty reason.

firmware.description: A flash recipe: the tool, the transport it uses, a pinned image, and the tool's own options. 'esptool' (ESP32 over serial) and 'uf2' (a mounted drive) today; 'dfu' later.

tool.description: The flashing tool. It implies the image format: .bin for esptool, .uf2 for uf2.

transport.description: How the board appears: a serial port in its bootloader, or a mounted drive. Must match the tool; the editor's dialog starts from it, and the user can pick another target of the same kind.

url.description: Where to download the image (http, https or file).

sha256.description: The image's sha256; a mismatch refuses the flash.

runtime.description: 'install' when the image has no Thingstudio runtime, so the editor installs it after flashing. Default 'none'.

flash.description: The tool's own options; unknown keys are refused. esptool: chip, baud, offset. uf2: none.

chip.description: esptool's chip id, e.g. esp32 or esp32s3. Omit to let esptool identify the chip.
